_meta.source: RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU, Annex II (as amended by Commission Delegated Directive (EU) 2015/863)
_meta.scope: Restricted in homogeneous materials of electrical and electronic equipment (EEE) placed on the EU market.
_meta.note: All 10 currently restricted substances -- this is the complete Annex II list, not a subset.

substances.name: Hexavalent chromium (Cr(VI))
substances.representative_note: RoHS restricts the Cr(VI) oxidation state, not a single compound; CAS shown (chromium(6+)) is the commonly-used representative reference, not the only Cr(VI) species covered.

substances.name: Polybrominated biphenyls (PBB)
substances.representative_note: PBB is a class of brominated-biphenyl congeners; CAS shown is a commonly-cited representative (Firemaster BP-6), not the only PBB congener covered.

substances.name: Polybrominated diphenyl ethers (PBDE)
substances.representative_note: PBDE is a class of brominated-diphenyl-ether congeners; CAS shown (decaBDE) is a commonly-cited representative, not the only PBDE congener covered.
